## Second `make verify`: same external cause, now proven by a controlled re-run

`MAKE_RC=2`, `14 failed, 19871 passed, 80 skipped in 5030.87s (1:23:50)` — slower again than
the first attempt (1:09:35) and far past AGENTS.md's 20-25 min, which by itself indicates the
host was more saturated, not less.

Signature census of the 14: **13 `GateCongestedError`** plus one
`subprocess.TimeoutExpired: Command '['claude', 'mcp', 'list']' timed out` — the latter also a
saturation artifact (that test shells out to the real CLI).

**The failure SET moved between runs while the signature stayed fixed.** Run 1 lost
`test_plan_review_cli_retry` and `test_opcert_producer_seam_8d8e`; run 2 lost
`test_plan_review_retry`, `test_plan_review_reuse` and
`test_completion_wrapper_duration_instrumentation` instead. A code defect does not migrate
between test modules across runs of the same tree; a contended lottery for a shared semaphore
does. Which tests lose depends only on scheduling.

**Controlled re-run settles it.** I re-ran the UNION of both runs' failures (19 tests)
serially, so at most one gate slot is ever needed: **18 failed, 1 passed**, every failure
`GateCongestedError`. At the same moment the host showed the semaphore fully consumed by a
different checkout:

```
7144/7168   01:32  rebar review-plan sphale…   (/Users/joeoakhart/comment-gates-current)
48404/48444 05:04  rebar review-plan snoopy…   (/Users/joeoakhart/comment-gates-current)
90578/90624 02:34  rebar review-plan …         (/Users/joeoakhart/comment-gates-current)
```

With zero of four slots free, EVERY gate-touching test fails deterministically regardless of
the tree under test. The same 19 tests passed earlier in this session (`33 passed` in a
sampled re-run) when slots were available. That is the control and its counterfactual.

**Conclusion, stated honestly rather than dressed up as green:** a clean local `make verify`
is not obtainable on this host while another checkout saturates the gate semaphore, and no
amount of re-running changes that — the contention is not mine to clear and I will not touch
another session's processes. What IS established:

- 19,871 tests passed on this tree, and the union of everything that did not has been shown to
  fail for a cause external to the change and to pass when that cause is absent.
- `test_pinned_ticket_view.py::…_fails_closed[packed]` — the original failure this ticket
  exists for — **passed in both full runs**.
- The authoritative verdict already exists anyway: change 2721 merged with a CI
  `Verified +1` from uncontended Linux runners, which is the gate that actually governs.

The local run is confirmatory only at this point, and it confirms nothing against the change.
